ruby-rainbow-1.mp3: Ruby the rabbit looks out at the rain. “Rain, rain!” says Ruby. She puts on her red boots.
ruby-rainbow-2.mp3: Ruby runs down the road. She sees a rose next to a rock. A robin rests on the rock.
ruby-rainbow-3.mp3: The rain stops. Ruby sees a rainbow! “Red is my favorite,” says Ruby. The robin sings along.
sunny-snake-1.mp3: Sammy the snake sits in the sun. “It is so warm,” says Sammy with a smile. She slides over the sand.
sunny-snake-2.mp3: Sammy sees six singing birds. She finds a shiny shell and a sparkly stone. “So special!” says Sammy.
sunny-snake-3.mp3: Sammy slides back home. The sunset is so sweet and soft. She feels safe and sleepy. “Shhhhh,” says Sammy.
happy-lion-1.mp3: Leo the lion looks up at the light. “What a lovely day!” he laughs. He limps along looking for his lost friend.
happy-lion-2.mp3: Leo finds a little lamb playing by the lake. “Let us play together!” says Leo. The lamb leaps with joy.
happy-lion-3.mp3: They laugh and leap all day long. The lion and lamb become the best of friends. “Life is so lovely!” says Leo.
thankful-tiger-1.mp3: Theo the tiger thinks about all he has. He thanks the tree for shade. He thanks the birds for their chirping.
thankful-tiger-2.mp3: Then Theo thanks his mother. “Thank you for everything!” he says. His mother is so happy. They hug together.
thankful-tiger-3.mp3: Theo realizes that thankful thoughts make him happy. He thinks about thank you every day. “That is the best thing!” he says.
cheerful-chipmunk-1.mp3: Charlie the chipmunk is cheerful and chubby. He chews on acorns and hops through the forest. “What a chance to explore!” he chirps.
cheerful-chipmunk-2.mp3: Charlie chases a chicken named Chester. “Will you be my friend?” asks Charlie. Chester chooses to chase right along with him!
cheerful-chipmunk-3.mp3: Charlie and Chester play by the creek and eat cherries. They chat and laugh. “This is the best, Charlie!” cheers Chester.
ziggy-zoo-1.mp3: Ziggy the zebra zooms to the zoo. “What a zigzag of animals!” she says with zest. She sees zebras, zany monkeys, and zippy lizards.
ziggy-zoo-2.mp3: Ziggy discovers a lazy zone where animals nap in the sun. “Zero energy here!” she laughs. The other zebras snooze peacefully.
ziggy-zoo-3.mp3: Before she zooms away, Ziggy realizes the zoo is such a wonderful place. “I am amazed!” she says with a big smile.
vivid-butterfly-1.mp3: Violet the butterfly has vivid violet wings. She ventures into a vast valley. “What a vast view!” she says with vigor.
vivid-butterfly-2.mp3: Violet meets a friendly vine growing on the trees. “Hello vine!” says Violet. The vine waves in the wind like it is greeting her.
vivid-butterfly-3.mp3: Violet visits a river and sees her vivid reflection. She values this moment. “What a valuable adventure!” says Violet happily.
funny-fox-1.mp3: Fiona the fox is funny and full of fun! She frolics in the forest and finds fresh fruit. “What a fantastic find!” she laughs.
funny-fox-2.mp3: Fiona finds a friendly frog named Felix. “Let us fish together!” says Fiona. Felix is so happy he falls in the water with a splash.
funny-fox-3.mp3: Fiona and Felix become forever friends. They flap and fidget with joy. “This friendship is fantastic!” says Fiona with a giggle.
joking-jaguar-1.mp3: Jammy the jaguar loves to jump and joke around. He jogs through the jungle in January. “What a joyful journey!” he says, juggling leaves.
joking-jaguar-2.mp3: Jammy meets Jake the jellyfish in a pond. “Tell me a joke!” says Jake. Jammy jests and makes Jake giggle with his silly jokes.
joking-jaguar-3.mp3: Jammy and Jake jump and jig together. Their laughter echoes through the jungle. “Journeying with you is the best joke of all!” says Jammy.
playful-penguin-1.mp3: Pete the penguin is playful and proud. He paddles through icy pools and plays with his pals. “Pick a partner!” says Pete with pep.
playful-penguin-2.mp3: Pete paints pretty pictures in the snow with his pebbles. A polar bear comes by to play. “Peek at my paintings!” says Pete proudly.
playful-penguin-3.mp3: Pete and the polar bear play all day. They play games, peek at penguins, and have a picnic. “Pals forever!” says Pete happily.
brave-bear-1.mp3: Bruno the bear is big and brave. He bounds through the forest looking for berries and bugs. “What a beautiful day!” he says with a big smile.
brave-bear-2.mp3: Bruno builds a bridge from broken branches. A baby butterfly needs help crossing. “I will build you a bridge!” says brave Bruno.
brave-bear-3.mp3: The butterfly and Bruno become the best of friends. They blend berries and make jam together. “Being friends is better than anything!” says Bruno.
timid-tiger-cub-1.mp3: Tilly the tiger cub is tiny and timid. She tiptoes through the trees, taking tiny steps. “I am too tiny!” she thinks. But a tall tree tells her she is talented.
timid-tiger-cub-2.mp3: The tall tree teaches Tilly to trust herself. “Try something tough!” says the tree. Tilly tackles climbing, and she does it! “I can do it!” she cheers.
timid-tiger-cub-3.mp3: Tilly tells everyone that tiny tigers can do tough things. She teaches other cubs to trust. “Together we are strong!” says Tilly with pride.
daisy-deer-1.mp3: Daisy the deer is determined and daring. She dances through the meadow. Daisies bloom all around her. “What a delightful day!” she says.
daisy-deer-2.mp3: Daisy discovers a dark den in the dirt. “What could be down there?” she wonders. A dodgy old turtle who is deaf comes out. “Do not be scared,” says the turtle.
daisy-deer-3.mp3: The turtle and Daisy drink from a deep pool. They dig and play in the dirt. At dusk, they dance together. “Do not dwell on fears,” says the wise turtle.
kind-kangaroo-1.mp3: Kate the kangaroo is kind and keeps everyone happy. She kicks a ball, does a kick, and keeps moving! “What a keen day!” she says with kindness.
kind-kangaroo-2.mp3: Kate sees a kite stuck in a tree. “I will help!” she says with a big kick. She knocks the kite down and keeps it safe.
kind-kangaroo-3.mp3: Kate keeps the kite and teaches a kitten to play with it. The kitten is so keen! “Being kind is the key to friendship,” says Kate happily.
graceful-giraffe-1.mp3: Grace the giraffe is graceful and kind. She glides through the grassland, being so gentle with everyone. “Goodness is everywhere!” she says with glee.
graceful-giraffe-2.mp3: Grace sees a little goose who is lost. “Come with me,” she says gently. Grace guides the goose through the grass with great care.
graceful-giraffe-3.mp3: The goose is so grateful to Grace. They grow into good friends. “Giving help makes the world grow brighter!” says Grace with a big grin.
wise-owl-1.mp3: Wendy the owl is wise and watches everything. She walks through the woods on a windy night. The wind whispers as she wanders along, wondering about the world.
wise-owl-2.mp3: Wendy warns a wild rabbit to watch out for danger. The rabbit is grateful. “I wish I was wise like you,” says the rabbit with wonder.
wise-owl-3.mp3: Wendy and the rabbit walk together, watching for wonders. They see wonderful stars twinkling in the window of the night sky. “What a wonderful world!” says Wendy.
yummy-yak-1.mp3: Yancy the yak is young and yappy. He yells “Yes!” to everything. “Yay!” he says, yielding to adventure. He yearns to explore the whole year long!
yummy-yak-2.mp3: Yancy yells a greeting to Yolanda, a young yak. “Yay, you are here!” he says. They yodel and yes to playing together. What a youthful pair!
yummy-yak-3.mp3: Yancy and Yolanda yield to the joy of friendship. They yodel and dance. “You are the yellow sunshine of my year!” says Yancy happily.
musical-monkey-1.mp3: Milo the monkey makes magical music! He marches through the meadow, moving to the melody. “Music makes me happy!” he says with a smile.
musical-monkey-2.mp3: Milo meets a mouse named Max who loves music too. “Make music with me!” says Milo merrily. Max mimics every move, and they make a marvelous duo.
musical-monkey-3.mp3: Milo and Max march through the mountains, making magnificent melodies. Everyone marvels at their music. “Music makes the world more wonderful!” says Milo.
naughty-newt-1.mp3: Nora the newt is naughty and gets into trouble. She naps in nooks but wakes up nervous. “Nobody is nice to me,” she thinks, but that is not nice thinking!
naughty-newt-2.mp3: A nice nightingale named Neil notices Nora is sad. “Do not be nervous,” says Neil sweetly. He sings near her. Nora is amazed by his kindness.
naughty-newt-3.mp3: Nora learns that being nice is nicer than being naughty. She and Neil become neighbors and friends. “Now I understand,” says Nora happily. “Niceness is the number one thing!”
